༄༅/ /mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/

bla ma dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs drug khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /rang bzhin nyid las ma 'das de yang ni/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis skyes pa'i mthar/ /'chi bar 'gyur ro shi ba'i tshe na yang*/ /rgyun chad mi 'gyur mngal la sogs pa yi/ /skye gnas rnam bzhi gang yang rung bar ni/ /skye bar 'gyur zhing de las gzhan du min/ /bskal ba dang po'i mi rnams rdzus skyes yin/ /lha dang dmyal ba srid pa bar do rnams/ /rdzus te skye yi 'gro ba gzhan dag las/ /'ga' zhig sgong skyes la la drod gsher skyes/ /phal cher mngal du skye bar 'gyur ba ste/ /de yang rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /thog ma ma rig dbang gis las bsags nas/ /las kyi bag chags rnam shes nyid la bsgos/ /sred len gnyis kyis yang yang gsos btab nas/ /srid las nus pa mthu can gyur ba'i tshe/ /rnam shes phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba na/ /skye ba ming gzugs 'bras bu'i rnam shes 'grub/ /rim gyis mig sogs skye mched drug po dang*/ /reg pa tshor ba rga shi mngon 'grub ste/ /de las mya ngan smre ngag 'don pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde sogs 'byung 'gyur zhing*/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam shes ming gzugs dang*/ /skye mched drug dang reg pa tshor ba dang*/ /sred dang len pa srid pa skye ba dang*/ /rga shi'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo bar mtshams med par 'khor/ /de yang dus dang dus min 'chi ba yis/ /'chi tshe drod ni stod smad gang rung nas/ /snying khar bsdus te srog 'gags rnam shes ni/ /phyir 'thon srang mda'i mtho dman ji bzhin du/ /rigs drug gang du skye ba'i bar do 'grub/ /de nas mngal du nying mtshams sbyor ba yang*/ /las kyi 'brel ba'i pha mar 'gyur ba gnyis/ /phan tshun thabs shes sbyor bar byed pa sogs/ /rgyu rkyen du ma tshogs la bltos pa

ste/ /tshogs pa ma tshang mngal du 'jug mi 'gyur/ /de yang grog ma'i rked pa 'dra la sogs/ /mngal gyi skyon rnams med cing dag pa dang*/ /zla mtshan ldan tshe mnyam par sbyor ba na/ /gnyis ka'i khams ni 'dus par gyur ba'i skabs/ / las kyi 'brel pas bar srid 'jug pa ste/ /de yang pho ru skye na ma la sred/ /pha nyid dang ni 'bral bar 'dod 'gyur la/ /gal te mo ru skye tshe pha la chags/ /ma la sdang ba'i blo ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de tshe pha ma nyal po byed pa ni/ /sgyu ma bzhin mthong nye bar phyogs pa na/ /pha ma mi mthong gnyis ka'i chos tsam zhig /mthong bas khros pas rkyen byas bar srid de/ /'chi 'pho byed par sa yi dngos gzhir gsungs/ /de tshe yang dag min pa'i 'du shes ni/ /grang dang rlung 'tshub char 'bab gnam 'thib cing*/ /skye bo mang bos sgra chen sgrog bzhin dang*/ /'du shes rnam bcu gang rung 'byung 'gyur te/ /rang nyid khang ba khang brtsegs gzhal med khang*/ /skyil bu khyim dang rtswa stug nags tshal dang*/ /rtsig pa'i bu ga sab mo'i gseb tu ni/ /'jug go snyam dang khri la 'dzeg snyam tshe/ /srid pa bar do 'gags nas rnam shes nyid/ /kha'am spyi bo mngal gyi sgo sogs nas/ /ma yi mngal du khams gnyis 'dus gyur ba/ /mer mer bo yi dbus su 'jug par 'gyur/ / dper na 'o ma snod dang srub shing dang*/ /skyes bu'i rtsol pa la brten mar 'byung ba/ /de bzhin thabs shes sbyor ba'i sa bon las/ /phyi ma'i lus ni 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /dper na rtswa sngon lci ba rgya shugs dang*/ /zho la brten nas srin bu skye 'gyur te/ /lus kyang sngo dang ser dang dmar dang dkar/ /'on kyang de dag srin bu ma yin la/ /srin bu nyid kyang de dag ma yin mod/ /'dus pa las ni srin bu'i lus 'grub bzhin/ /las kyi rkyen stobs pha ma'i khams dag las/ / lus ni 'grub par 'gyur te khams de nyid/ /lus min lus kyang khams nyid min mod kyang*/

/'dus las rim gyis lus ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /de tshe sa yi khams kyis sra bar byed/ /chu yis gsher zhing mes dro rlung gis g.yo/ /gal te khams bzhi med na mer mer bo/ /bskams sam rul zhing 'phel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir 'byung ba chen po de dag ni/ /las kyi rgyu byas gcig gis gcig rkyen byas/ /de mthus rnam par shes pa skye zhing gnas/ /sa yi khams kyis rten byed chu yis sdud/ /me yis smin cing rlung gis 'phel bar byed/ /dper na btab pa'i nas kyi myu gu ni/ /brlan gsher la sogs rkyen kun tshogs pa'i tshe/ /'byung gi re re kho nas ma yin ltar/ /pha ma rnam shes khams rnams 'dus pa las/ /skye ba len gyi re re kho nas min/ /de tshe mer mer bo ni gzugs yin la/ /tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes bzhi/ /ming zhes bya ste bsdoms pas ming gzugs so/ /ma yi mngal gnas tshad ni zhag gi grangs/ /bdun phrag so brgyad lhag tsam yod pa ste/ /de yang bdun phrag dang po'i gnas skabs tshe/ /sdug bsngal 'di ltar rab tu 'thob 'gyur te/ /tsha ba'i snod du btsos shing brngos pa bzhin/ /de tshe mer mer bo la brten pa'i dus/ /de ni zho yi spros ma bzhin du chags/ /bdun phrag gnyis par sngar bzhin sdug bsngal bar/ /de tshe kun tu reg pa zhes bya ba'i/ /las kyi rlung byung mngal der reg pa na/ /nur nur bor 'gyur zho ni bska ba'am/ /mar 'khyag bzhin te rab tu btsos pa na/ khams bzhi mngon snang go gor bo nyid 'gyur/ /bdun phrag gsum par ma yi mngal nas ni/ /mdzod ka zhes bya'i rlung byung reg pa na/ /ltar ltar bor 'gyur srin bu gro ma bzhin/ /bdun phrag bzhi bar rab tu 'byed pa'i rlung*/ /mngon par byung bas mngal der reg pa na/ /mkhrang 'gyur zhes bya dbyibs ni bor ba bzhin/ /bdun phrag lnga bar sdud pa zhes bya ba'i/ /rlung byung reg pas dpung pa gnyis ka dang*/

/brla gnyis mgo ste lnga bo mngon tsam 'byung*/ /drug par rgya che zhes bya'i rlung byung ste/ /dpung pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis dang pus mo bskyed/ /bdun par 'khyil ba zhes bya'i las rlung gis/ /reg pas rkang lag rnam bzhi snang bar 'gyur/ /brgyad par bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i rlung gis ni/ /sor mo nyi shu gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /dgu bar rnam par 'byed pa'i rlung byung ste/ /mig gnyis rna ba gnyis dang sna bug gnyis/ kha dang bshang lam gci ba'i sgo dgu snang*/ /bcu bar sra bar byed pa'i rlung gis ni/ /mngal gyi gnas pa sra zhing brtan par byed/ /de tshe skye ba zhes bya'i rlung gis kyang*/ /mngal gnas rkyal ba bus te gang bzhin byed/ /bcu gcig pa la gnyis snang zhes bya'i rlung*/ /byung des khong stong nyid du byed 'gyur zhing*/ /bu ga dgu bo gsal bar snang bar 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis la bab yod pa'i sgo yi rlung*/ /'byung zhing des ni nang khrol rgyu ma bskyed/ /de tshe bsdu ba rgyus pa'i rlung gis ni/ /tshigs ni sum brgya drug cu byed par 'gyur/ /bcu gsum pa la sngar gyi las rlung des/ /bkres skom shes byed ma yis zos 'thung ba/ /zhu nas de yi lus la phan 'dogs byed/ /bcu bzhi ba la skud pa kha yi rlung*/ /zhes byas rtsa rgyus stong phrag skyed par byed/ /de yang lus kyi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhir/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu lnga bcu gnas par 'dod/ /bco lngar padma zhes bya'i rlung byung ste/ /rtsar rgyu ba ni rnam pa nyi shu bskyed/ /de ni lus kyi phyogs bzhir lnga lnga gnas/ /rtsar rgyu re rer yang ni bzhi bcu re/ /lus kyi phyogs bzhir nyis brgya nyis brgya ste/ /khyon bsdoms brgyad brgya re re la yang ni/ /phan tshun 'brel bas brgya brgya yod pa rnams/ /bsdoms pas stong phrag brgyad cu 'byung 'gyur te/ /de yang lus kyi mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhir/ /stong phrag nyi shu nyi shu yod par gsung*/

/bcu drug pa la bdud rtsi 'gro ba'i rlung*/ /byung bas mig gnyis rna ba sna bug gi /skye mched 'grub cing kha sgo mid pa dang*/ /snying gi khor yug bza' btung myangs pa kun/ /'jug pa'i gnas dang dbugs kyang rgyu bar byed/ /bcu bdun 'bri gdong zhes bya'i rlung gis ni/ /mig rna la sogs lhag par dang byed cing*/ /dbugs kyang phyi nang thogs med rgyu bar byed/ /bco brgyad par ni dri ma med pa'i rlung*/ /zhes byas skye mched yongs su dag par byed/ /bcu dgu pa la sngar gyi rlung des ni/ /mig dang rna ba sna lce'i dbang bo 'grub/ /nyi shur shin tu brtan pa'i rlung gis ni/ /sems can de yi rkang pa g.yas g.yon gyi/ /sor mo'i rus pa nyi shu nyi shu dang*/ /rkang ba'i phyi rting rus pa bzhi rnams dang*/ /rje ngar pus mo'i rus pa gnyis gnyis dang*/ /rked pa long bu'i rus pa gsum gsum dang*/ /sgal tshigs kyi ni rus pa bco brgyad dang*/ /rtsib ma'i rus pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi bskyed/ /gzhan yang lag pa g.yas g.yon la brten te/ /sor mo'i rus pa nyi shu nyi shu byed/ /lag ngar 'gram pa'i rus pa gnyis gnyis dang*/ /mgo dang dpung ba gnya' rus bzhi bzhi dang*/ /brang dang phrag pa'i rus pa bdun bdun dang*/ /so yi rus pa sum cu rtsa gnyis bskyed/ /mdor na rus pa phra mo ma gtogs pa'i/ /rus chen nyis brgya rab tu bskyed par byed/ /nyer gcig yang dag bskyed pa'i rlung byung nas/ /de yi lus kyi sha rnams kun nas bskyed/ /nyer gnyis kun tu rgyas pa'i rlung byung ste/ /lus kyi khrag rnams rab tu bskyed par 'gyur/ /nyer gsum yongs dag 'dzin pa'i rlung las ni/ /lus kyi pags pa'i khyad par bskyed par byed/ /nyer bzhi kun tu 'phyo ba'i rlung byung ste/ /pags pa'i mdog ni gsal bar byed par 'gyur/ /nyer snga ba la grong 'dzin rlung gis ni/ /sha dang khrag rnams rab tu dang bar byed/

/nyer drug skye ba mngon par 'grub pa yis/ /skra dang ba spu sen mo'i khyad par bskyed/ /nyer bdun sman yon chen po'i rlung byung nas/ /skra spu sen mo mdog dang ldan par byed/ /de tshe sngon gyi las dang rkyen gzhan mthus/ /lus kyi bkod pa'i bzang ngan khyad par bskyed/ /pho yin ma yi rtsib ma'i g.yas phyogs dang*/ /bu mo yin na g.yon gyi phyogs su ni/ /tsog bur lag pa gnyis kyis gdong bkab ste/ /bu rgyab bu mo mdun phyogs kha bltas 'dug /de tshe ma ni chong dang rgyugs pa dang*/ /tsha dang grang ba'i kha zas zos 'thung bas/ /mngal na gnas de g.yang du lhung ba dang*/ /kun tu btsir bas pags pa bshus bzhin dang*/ /grang dang tsha sogs dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bzhin/ /mthong mod skyes tshe dran pa rmongs nas brjed/ /nyer brgyad pa la phyin ci log pa yi/ /'du shes brgyad po ci rigs 'byung 'gyur te/ /mngal du khyim dang gzhon pa khang brtsegs dang*/ /kun dga' ra ba skyed tshal khri la 'dug /chu dang rdzing bu'i 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing*/ /de yang dge ba byed la bzang bo dang*/ /mi dge byed par ngan pa'i snang ba 'char/ /nyer dgu pa la me tog phreng ba yi/ /rlung zhes bya bas kha dog sna tshogs byed/ /de yang las kyis 'brel ba'i pha ma yi/ /lus kyi mdog dang rjes su mthun pa'am/ /yang na mi 'dra bzang ngan ci rigs 'gyur/ /sum cu ba la lcags kyi sgo zhes pa'i/ /rlung gis bus pas skra spu lhag par 'phel/ /de bzhin so gcig so gnyis so gsum dang*/ /so bzhi ba la'ang las kyi rlung gis ni/ /lus kyi cha rnams rgya cher 'phel bar byed/ /so lnga ba la yan lag nying lag kun/ /rdzogs par 'gyur gyi de yi gong du min/ /so drug pa la mngal du 'dug mi 'dod/ /so bdun la bab mi gtsang dri mi zhim/ /mun nag 'thib 'dra'i yang dag 'du shes 'byung*/ /bdun phrag so brgyad gnas skabs son pa'i tshe/ /ma yi mngal nas me tog sdud ces pa'i/

/las kyi rlung byung mngal gyi sems can de/ /mgo thur bsgyur zhing lag pa gnyis brkyangs nas/ /skye ba'i sgo ru phyogs pa'i bya ba byed/ /so brgyad mthar ram rdzogs nas zhag bzhi sogs/ /song tshe kha thur blta ba'i las kyi rlung*/ /byung nas mngal na 'dug pa'i sems can de/ /rkang pa gyen du byas te bcum nas ni/ /phyi ru phul te skye ba'i sgo nas dbyung*/ /'on kyang kha cig zhag grangs ma tshang dang*/ /'ga' zhig lhag pa nyid du gnas pa'ang srid/ /btsa' dus btsir bas pags pa bshus 'dra ba'i/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ /mas kyang srog la 'bab pa lta bu yi/ /sdug bsngal myong zhing 'chi ba nyid kyang srid/ /btsas nas 'jam pa'i stan la bzhag pa'am/ /sor mos blangs tshe tsher ma'i nang lhung ltar/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong*/ kha cig sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen gyis/ /rkang lag log cing bsnol mar byung gyur nas/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs nyid nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /btsas nas nyin zhag bdun pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lus la srin bu phra mo 'bum byung nas/ /lus kyi gnas nyid za bar byed pa ste/ /srin bu kha cig skra yi rtsa ba za/ /de bzhin mgo bo glad pa mig rtsa dang*/ /la la rna ba sna dang sha rus pags/ /rtsa rus nang khrol sogs la gnas bcas nas/ /za phyir lus 'di srin bu'i tshang bzhin no/ /gzhan yang sha rus rnag khrag bshang gci dang*/ /snabs dang ngar snabs mchil ma la sogs pa/ /mi gtsang rdzas kyi dngos po so drug dang*/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad kyi gzhi/ /mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo 'di/ /mi gtsang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /'byung gnas sdug bden nyid las ma 'das phyir/ /bde bar sems pa gang yin rmongs pas 'khrul/ /bdag phung skye dang rga ba la sogs kyang*/ /dkar nag las dang nyon mongs rkyen dbang gis/ /'grub par 'gyur gyi byed po gzhan med pas/

/rang dbang grub pa'i bdag ni yod ma yin/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i byed las ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de'i rags par yang*/ /rmongs pa kha cig bu dang bu mo nyid/ /bdag cag rang dbang kho na bskyed snyam sems/ /de lta yin na bu dang bu mo yi/ /mig sna rna ba lce dang sgal tshigs dang*/ /rtsa rgyus rgyu ma snying mchin glo ba sogs/ /lus kyi phyi nang bkod pa ji snyed pa/ /de dag khyed cag gis ni byas sam ci/ /yin na mkhas te sngon med ngo mtshar che/ /de ltar mngal gyi gnas tshul legs shes na/ /gtsang bde rtag pa bdag tu lta la sogs/ /rmongs pa'i lta ngan gdon las grol 'gyur zhing*/ /yang dag lta ba 'dren pa'i bag chags 'jog /ji skad brjod de 'jig rten khams 'di 'dra'i/ /mngal skyes nyid kyi dbang du byas pa ste/ /mngon dga'i zhing na skyes pa bud med gnyis/ /'khrig pa'i sbyor ba med kyang chags sems kyis/ /bud med gang la yud tsam bltas pa na/ /de nyid sbrum mar 'gyur la de phyin chad/ /'dod chags bral ba'i ting 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur/ /bud med kun kyang lha mo gzhon nu bzhin/ /rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms yid 'phrog ma/ /mngal du khye'u'am bu mo chags gyur na/ /ma bu gnyis la'ang sdug bsngal gtan med cing*/ /shin tu bde chen nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ /bu yi lus kyang pha ma'i sa bon las/ / grub pa min phyir mngal nas skye ba'i tshe/ /chu ser khrag sogs mi gtsang rigs kun gyis/ /gos pa med par shel gyi khang ba nas/ /phyi rol 'byung ba ji bzhin bde bar btsa'/ /zhing de'i mi rnams lha bzhin mdzes mtshungs shing*/ /phun tshogs skyid pa'i dga' bder rtag spyod pas/ /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang yod min la/ /shi 'phos gyur tshe'ang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs med ldan pa dang*/ /'phags pa'i gang zag grangs med dpag tu med/ /gang dag bde bzhin skye dang gnas 'dod na/

/mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhing der skye 'gyur ba'i/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong smon lam rlabs chen thob/ /des ni de ru skye zhes rgyal bas bshad/ /mdor na mngon dga' bde ba can gnyis kyi/ /zhing gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ /mtshungs pa nyid ces mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ /zhing der skye ba smon rnams skal ba bzang*/ /de 'dra'i dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas kyang*/ /ma dag zhing gi 'gro rnams 'dren snyam du/ / dam bca' snying rjes drangs pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /shugs drag smon lam 'debs la zhugs na legs/ /ci phyir zhe na snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ni/ /rang cag lta bu dang bo'i las can gyis/ /sa lam mthon po bskyed par dka' ba'i phyir/ /re zhig 'dun pa de ltar gtong bar rigs/ /tshul 'dir tshul bzhin 'bad las byung ba'i dges/ /skye dang skye bar dal 'byor rten rnyed cing*/ /yang dang yang du chos la spyod pa yis/ /myur ba myur bar sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /ces dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i me long zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis bskul pas rkyen byas te/ /shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/ thub pa'i dbang pos legs par bshad pa'i don bzhin gzhan gyis kyang shes na ci ma rung snyam nas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ mngal du 'jug pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i me long bzhugs/ - PAGE 206-- PAGE 205-- PAGE 197-
